targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, 'readings/min' AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM fire_detection_sim.sensor_readings WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT NOW() AS time, 'Total Readings' AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM fire_detection_sim.sensor_readings WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
SELECT NOW() AS time, 'Active Rooms' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT room)::float AS value FROM fire_detection_sim.sensor_readings WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute'
SELECT NOW() AS time, 'Fire Events' AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM fire_detection_sim.fire_events WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
SELECT NOW() AS time, 'Sensor Types' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT sensor_type)::float AS value FROM fire_detection_sim.sensor_readings WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute'
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, level AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM fire_detection_sim.sensor_readings WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, level ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, sensor_type AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM fire_detection_sim.sensor_readings WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, sensor_type ORDER BY 1

SELECT time,
                    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - LAG(time) OVER (ORDER BY time)))::float AS interval_sec
                FROM fire_detection_sim.fire_events
                WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
                ORDER BY time
SELECT NOW() AS time, 'sensor_readings' AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM fire_detection_sim.sensor_readings
SELECT NOW() AS time, 'fire_events' AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM fire_detection_sim.fire_events
SELECT NOW() AS time, 'actuator_events' AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM fire_detection_sim.actuator_events
